messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — launching a mini-matrix sanity run for model v5.2-quant4v2. 1% traffic, 6h smoke, focusing on holdout slices and sequence-consistency (seq-cons) errors.
oliver: SGTM. Which slices are we prioritizing?
sara: prioritize: long-form docs, conversational follow-up, and code-gen edge prompts. add the 'prompt-shift' holdout we saw last week.
maya: yep — those three plus session-continuity slice. Canary config: rolling windows of 15m, compare MRR, hallucination rate, and token-prefix mismatch. fallback trigger if any holdout shows >1.5% absolute MRR drop AND p<0.05.
aris: typo — p-values on A/B will be noisy at 1% traffic. can we also add a more conservative delta rule: immediate autoscale fallback if |MRR_delta| > 3% for 30m?
maya: good call. So two parallel checks: statistical gate (1.5% & p<0.05) OR operational safety gate (3% absolute delta sustained 30m).
oliver: also add seq-consistency metric: fraction of responses where token-by-token alignment to baseline diverges within first 50 tokens. we saw weird early drift in quant4v1. set threshold 8% divergence as flag.
sara: +1 on seq-consistency. for hallucination rate, measure F1 overlap with ground truth on the QA holdout; flag if F1 drops >4 points.
canary-bot: canary run started (id=cmx-5055). collecting metrics to /canary/mini-matrix/v5.2-quant4v2/5055551234. expected ~6h.
maya: notes for telemetry: capture prefix-kv hit rate, avg latency p50/p95/p99, and prompt token distribution. if p99 latency increases by >120ms AND error rate >0.3% trigger immediate rollback.
aris: about entropy-based sample backoff — can we throttle low-entropy completions to reduce impact on eval metrics? i suggest sampling cap: if output entropy < 1.2 nats for a given prompt class, cut that slice traffic by 50% and shadow it.
oliver: that's a neat hack. Implementation: routing rule in experiment config -> sample_backoff: {slice: "low_entropy", cap: 0.5}. keep as shadow to collect signals.
sara: timeline: run 6h smoke then extend to 24h if no flags. will run differential A/B with control=v5.1-fp16. store per-prompt deltas.
maya: final decision: start the 1% mini-matrix now. if any of the three automatic gates (statistical, operational, latency+errors) trip, canary-bot will auto-fallback to control. Team: watch slack alerts, I'll post quick periodic summaries. :thumbsup:
